SELECT tier, is_current, (valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31') AS open_ended, count(*) AS versions, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, min(valid_from) AS min_from, max(valid_from) AS max_from, min(join_date) mn_join, max(join_date) mx_join
FROM dim_member GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

WITH per AS (
  SELECT member_id, count(*) n, sum(is_current::int) cur, sum((valid_to=DATE '9999-12-31')::int) open_n
  FROM dim_member GROUP BY member_id)
SELECT cur, open_n, count(*) members, sum(n) versions FROM per GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

WITH active AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  WHERE f.sale_date > DATE '2026-10-04' - 364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2026-10-04')
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND tier='Gold') AS gold_current,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member c JOIN active a USING (member_id) WHERE c.is_current AND c.tier='Gold') AS gold_active,
       (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE tier='Gold') gold_ever,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND tier='Gold' AND join_date > DATE '2026-10-07') future_join
